title: JobStatisticsService
responsibility: Summarize completed duration samples and select exact, model, type or global distributions with conditional running-job residuals.

inputs.name: JobStatisticsService.constructor.records
inputs.description: Duration records whose pass/fail outcomes and finite durations contribute samples; cancelled and unfinished jobs are excluded.

inputs.name: JobStatisticsService.estimate.type
inputs.description: Job phase category requested for duration estimation, such as contract, stub, smell or reverify.

inputs.name: JobStatisticsService.estimate.model
inputs.description: Model identifier requested for a duration distribution; exact matching precedes model-only, type-only and global fallbacks.

inputs.name: JobStatisticsService.estimate.elapsedMs
inputs.description: Already elapsed running time in milliseconds, default zero. Surviving samples estimate residuals; exhausted tails are explicitly extrapolated.

outputs.name: JobStatisticsService.summary
outputs.description: Per-type/model counts, numerically stable incremental means, conventional medians and nearest-rank p80/p90 durations.

outputs.name: JobStatisticsService.estimate
outputs.description: Queue service returns status, counts, slots, p50/p90 makespans, Lisbon finish clocks and sample notes. Statistics service returns a selected distribution or null when history has no usable samples.
